transcript: Speaker A (Tomato): Which pasta would you like? White sauce, red sauce or pink sauce? Speaker B (Okra): I'll take the red sauce. Speaker C (Avocado): I'll have the pink sauce. It looks delicious. Speaker A (Tomato): What about you, Gobi? Speaker D (Cauliflower): मुझे कोई भी दे दीजिए, मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा [Give me any, I don't understand]. Speaker E (Cabbage): क्या हुआ गोभी? तुम रो क्यों रही हो? [What happened Gobi? Why are you crying?] Speaker D (Cauliflower): आज किटी पार्टी में सब मुझपे हँसे क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश बोलनी नहीं आती। [Today at the kitty party everyone laughed at me because I don't know how to speak English.] Speaker E (Cabbage): बस इतनी सी बात? तुम PW Talk ऐप यूज़ करना शुरू करो। इसमें एक AI इंग्लिश टीचर है, रिया। तुम इससे रोज़ 10 मिनट बात करो, ये तुम्हें इंग्लिश बोलना सिखा देगी। गलती भी हो तो शर्माओ मत, रिया जज नहीं करेगी। [Just this? Start using the PW Talk app. It has an AI English teacher, Riya. Talk to her for 10 minutes daily, she will teach you English without judging.]
on_screen_text: Which pasta would you like? White sauce, red sauce or pink sauce / I'll take the red sauce / I'll have the pink sauce / It looks delicious / What about you Gobi? / Mujhe koi bhi de dijiye mujhe samajh nahi aa raha / Kya hua Gobi Tum roh kyu rahi ho? / Aaj kitty party mein sab mujh pe hase kyunki mujhe English bolni nahi aati / Bas itni si baat Yeh lo / Tum PW Talk app use karna shuru karo / Dekho isme ek AI English teacher hai Riya / Tum isse roz 10 minute baat karo / Yeh tumhe English bolna sikha degi / Galti bhi ho to sharmao mat / Riya judge nahi karegi / Yeh tumhe daily life me English me kaise baat karna hai yeh sikha degi / Isme dher saare practice questions aur videos hain tumhare liye jisse tum English bolna seekh sakti ho / Daily practice karo level up karo aur dekho kaise mahiene bhar me tum confidently English bolne lagti ho / Phir dekhte hain kiski himmat hai jo tumhara mazaak udaye
summary: An animated cauliflower character is ridiculed at a party for not understanding English. Her cabbage friend consoles her and suggests using the PW Talk app, which features an AI tutor named Riya to practice English daily without judgment. The ad promotes the app as a way to build speaking confidence within a month.
